# Mouzi 0.2.1

Fixes untranslated controls introduced in 0.2.0. Update from inside Mouzi or download a package below. Your existing settings, rules and history are preserved.

- Translate the review queue, folder options, rule conditions, rename templates, history filters, confirmations and error messages into all 11 supported interface languages.
- Add the missing Spanish archive-import strings.
- Move the new strings into the standard locale JSON files so contributors can translate them alongside the rest of the interface.
- Check every locale for missing keys, empty strings and mismatched placeholders in CI, with English fallback disabled during the lookup tests.

Addresses [#67](https://github.com/hsr88/mouzi/issues/67). This patch does not change file-organization behavior.

Windows packages are not Authenticode-signed. Tauri updater signatures verify update integrity separately; SHA256SUMS.txt contains the download checksums. Linux packages target x86_64. macOS remains unofficial and experimental.

[Downloads](https://mouzi.cc/download) · [Changelog](https://mouzi.cc/changelog)
